name: default
source: Stock Roblox R15. THIS IS THE DEFAULT PROFILE for the skill - a map built for a generic game, not for any one project's custom movement controller.
note: Stock gravity is 196.2, not 120. That single difference makes the stock jump roughly 6.4 studs up and 8.2 studs across, against 10.4 and 13.3 under a gravity-120 game. A gap sized for one is wrong for the other, so always name the profile a map is built against.

autoStep.note: Roblox auto-step. Stairs and slabs taller than this are unclimbable ladders - see references/movement-numbers.md

designMaxSlope.note: what a RAMP should honour even though the engine allows more
